content: Retrieving responses for the target character depends on the other candidate responses. For example, dialogue retrieval performance for Grissom from CSI, which is a crime/police context, is higher than other evaluation characters (see Table TABREF45), potentially due to other candidate responses not falling within the same crime/police context.
